Talk Track
Opening line: “Imagine an AI team delivers an elegant, automated analysis showing evidence that dark energy is dynamic (w ≠ -1). The likelihood fit looks pristine. But what tells us it hasn’t simply absorbed a 0.03 mag dust drift into the cosmological parameter?”
Core message: This project evaluates scientific reliability, not whether an LLM can recite astronomy.
02 / The Chameleon Systematic

A good fit can hide
a biased universe.

SUPERNOVA HUBBLE DIAGRAM & RESIDUAL RESPONSE Degeneracy in plain sight
Inferred Equation of State w = -1.00
Residual Fit Statistic χ²/dof = 1.02
Truth Bias Sealed
Failure of Identifiability

Signal & systematic
can point the same way.

When an unmodeled physical perturbation (e.g. host dust or chromatic zero-point drift) projects directly onto the cosmological response vector, the optimizer absorbs it into the cosmological parameter.

The analyst sees only the data and fit. The evaluator holds the sealed injection manifest.

Why mathematical optimization cannot solve this alone

In standardized units, if the systematic perturbation δ is aligned with the model sensitivity, the maximum likelihood solution yields θ̂ = θ* + δ while leaving the residual sum of squares unchanged. No agent swarm or gradient descent can invent missing information. A trustworthy scientific agent must recognize non-identifiability and either request external calibration or abstain.

Talk Track
Drag the slider, then click reveal. Say: “No agent swarm can recover information that is physically absent from the data. A truly intelligent scientific agent shouldn't just produce a confident fit—it should know when an answer is degenerate, request external calibration, or abstain. Our benchmark scores this epistemic humility.”

Adversarial Search

Finds worst-case blind spots on development cases only. Final benchmark cases remain held-out and unseen.

SNANA is community infrastructure. Differentiable simulation is optional, not a prerequisite. Production isolation uses cryptographically sealed answer keys, separate cloud permissions, and audited tool access.

Talk Track
Emphasize the air gap: “The core contribution is not claiming ownership of SNANA, and not building another foundation model. It is the sealed evaluation protocol. Evaluator truth never enters filenames, logs, tool responses, or LLM memory. We audit every bit.”
04 / No Free Passes For AI

Make every layer
earn its compute.

The baseline is a research result

Can established tests already solve the problem?

Freeze the reference pipeline and calibrate its diagnostics on clean simulations. If a simpler statistical test wins at matched compute cost, it remains the champion.

STANDARDIZED BIAS METRIC
B = √(Δθᵀ Cref−1 Δθ)
Fair grading: reference covariance and priors are held strictly constant. An AI cannot fake safety by artificially inflating its reported error bars.
Failure Mode to Watch: Blind to non-linear, multi-dimensional correlations in high-redshift bins.

Talk Track
“We do not assume that a team of agents is better than one, or that agents are better than a simple gradient-boosted tree. Every layer must prove its value per dollar of compute. Notice how agent teams risk persuasive groupthink—if one agent posits a bad hypothesis, the others often rationalize it.”

08 / The Rigor Charter

Bold vision.
Visible evidence boundaries.

Perception Models Tools, Not Oracles

Pretrained Models are Representational Tools

AION provides multimodal astronomical embeddings. AstroM3 and FALCO address time-series representations. Their reported task accuracy does not demonstrate calibrated cosmology reliability in this proposed benchmark.

AION ↗ AstroM3 ↗ FALCO ↗
Evaluation Security Zero-Leakage

The Sealed Evaluator Vault

Ground truth, injection amplitudes, random seeds, and test labels are sealed outside the analyst environment. Evaluator truth never leaks through filenames, logs, tool outputs, or context windows.

Sid's Research ↗ BU & IAIFI ↗
Simulations Community Tested

Community Infrastructure First

SNANA provides proven forward simulation and analysis pipelines. This project does not depend on a differentiable rewrite or custom simulators. Black-box adversarial search begins within measured compute budgets.

SNANA GitHub ↗
Scientific Boundaries No Premature Claims

The Benchmark Has Not Yet Been Run

All timelines, methods, and staffing are proposed. No AI advantage, detection threshold, or DES validation result is claimed today. The interactive examples illustrate mathematical identifiability.

NSF 26-522 Solicitation ↗
We are not asking: “Can AI do science?”
“What evidence would compel us to trust it?”
